title: Observability: spans, redaction and experiment identity
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects observability: spans, redaction and experiment identity with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. During a simulated outage, the trace should identify the failing dependency, retry attempts and final fallback without exposing credentials.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A trace links operations within one task; spans describe timed units such as retrieval, provider calls and tools. Logs record events, metrics summarize distributions and user feedback contributes product outcomes. Correlation IDs connect these views without requiring sensitive text in every record.

AI observability adds prompt/model versions, retrieval IDs, token usage, cost, finish reasons and validation outcomes. Raw prompts and responses may contain private data, so visibility needs access controls, redaction and retention.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Use OpenTelemetry spans around domain stages and propagate context into HTTP/tool calls. Record safe attributes such as task ID, model ID, mode, duration and counts. Store sensitive evidence separately under controlled access, referencing it by ID.
MLflow, LangSmith or Phoenix can organize traces and experiments; keep portable run JSON as a baseline. Attach dataset/prompt/index revisions so a quality change can be correlated with a release.
sections.code:
from opentelemetry import trace
tracer=trace.get_tracer('ci-quality')
with tracer.start_as_current_span('retrieve') as span:
    span.set_attribute('retrieval.index_version','v1')

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A dashboard shows average latency but cannot distinguish queue delay from model delay. A trace logs Authorization headers or synthetic canaries. An evaluator failure appears as a successful model span.
Test attribute redaction, parent-child span relationships, error status and correlation across retries. Track p95 and failure slices, not only global means.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: During a simulated outage, the trace should identify the failing dependency, retry attempts and final fallback without exposing credentials. Quality reports should link to the corresponding safe trace ID.
SDETs can assert observability contracts as part of integration tests: required spans exist, status matches the outcome and prohibited attributes never appear.

title: Trace correlation and safe telemetry assertions
objectives: Trace correlation and safe telemetry assertions
Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects trace correlation and safe telemetry assertions with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance evidence shows a complete trace for a normal request and an injected failure, with no canary or credential attributes.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A trace is useful only when its spans explain the user task. Queue, retrieval, provider, validation and tool spans should share context while recording their own durations and statuses. A random request ID in every log without shared linkage cannot reconstruct the task.
Telemetry is also a data surface. Prompt text, authorization headers and evidence from restricted tenants should not become broadly accessible trace attributes.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: The local OpenTelemetry example emits a parent release-evaluation span and a child deterministic-cases span with dataset and mode attributes. Add domain spans around dependency calls, propagate trace context and mark failures at the responsible stage.

Keep safe scalar attributes and controlled artifact references. Redact structured sensitive fields recursively; use a dedicated protected store for raw evidence when the product requires it. Configure retention and reader access independently from application access.

python local-labs/frameworks/tracing.py
# Inspect parent_span_id, dataset.version and evaluation.passed in output

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A provider failure is swallowed and the span remains successful. Retry attempts have no parent, preventing correlation. A nested header includes a secret despite a top-level redactor.

Test required span names, parent IDs, error statuses, attempt counts and forbidden attributes using an in-memory exporter. Preserve a synthetic canary test so privacy regressions in telemetry are visible.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Acceptance evidence shows a complete trace for a normal request and an injected failure, with no canary or credential attributes. Version IDs connect the trace to the evaluation run and release manifest.

SDETs can make observability assertions deterministic even when model quality is probabilistic. A useful trace explains the first failed boundary and the visible fallback without exposing sensitive content.

mistake: A provider failure is swallowed and the span remains successful. Retry attempts have no parent, preventing correlation. A nested header includes a secret despite a top-level redactor.
takeaway: Acceptance evidence shows a complete trace for a normal request and an injected failure, with no canary or credential attributes.
